alerts.name: PULBASE staging - service health (1 DOWN, 2 RECOVERED, 3 NO DATA)
alerts.description: Staging only. Value 1: service DOWN (2 failed probes); 2: RECOVERED (3 healthy probes, shown for 30 min); 3: NO MONITOR DATA for 20 min. 0: healthy, no mail. Checked every 5 min, repeat every 15 min. Recovery delivery may wait up to 15 min plus evaluation/ingestion delay; up to 2 recovery reminders. Check dashboard current value before acting. Existing cost/usage alerts are unchanged.
alerts.query: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 3 WHEN argMax(double1, timestamp) >= 1 THEN 1 WHEN argMax(double6, timestamp) > 0 AND argMax(double4, timestamp) - argMax(double6, timestamp) < 1800 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM events.analyticsEngine.pulbase_service_health WHERE accountTag = '60e5472a284dc71bbafbbfac8aa2a940' AND blob1 = 'staging' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '20' MINUTE
